name: Warsmith
notes: Golem logic: Mechanic Golem 25 costs D crystals at levels 1-2 and C crystals from level 3 and eats crystals over time: keep crystals stocked or the golem vanishes. Summon it before the hunt, resummon when it dies.
Siege Golem, Wild Hog Cannon and Swoop Cannon: siege only, never. Merchant Golem: never in combat.

rows.trig: Attack: auto-attack (dagger or blunt). No damage skills in this band.

Spoil (10): per the spoil logic, from 10 on. Spoil logic 1: spoil the target before it dies, ideally as the first action (magic land chance, 40 range). If it says "spoil failed", retry once or twice while the mob has > 30 % HP. Skip low-value mobs. In a party the spoiler spoils while the others hold their attacks for about 1 s, or the spoiler opens the pull.

Sweeper (10): per the spoil logic, from 10 on. Spoil logic 3: sweep every spoiled corpse right after the kill, before picking up drops (drops stay on the ground longer than corpses). Make sweep priority 1 the moment a spoiled mob dies; corpses last about 7 s on L2J, longer for spoiled ones [?]. 0.5 s reuse, 20 range, needs a corpse.
Fatal Strike (sword/blunt), then Hammer Crush filler.
Then Hammer Crush (blunt, stun) filler.
Polearm: >= 2 mobs on you. The l2-hub guide says polearm group pulls from 40 give "far more XP".
Pet: Mechanic Golem — see the golem logic (summon before the hunt, resummon when it dies; keep crystals stocked).
Pet: golem support skill — Golem Reinforcement (20 min; cast on summon).
Pet: golem support skill — Strengthen Golem (20 min; cast on summon).
Pet: golem support skill — Repair Golem (heals the golem) when golem HP < 50 %.

Golem logic: Summon Big Boom (58+, D crystals) is an explosive servitor for an AoE burst on a big pack that doesn't put aggro on the dwarf (StrategyWiki snippet). Situational only, not part of the normal loop [?].
